newsitem.title: USA: Gilead,Hoffman start Phase II GS 4104 test.
newsitem.headline: Gilead,Hoffman start Phase II GS 4104 test.

text.p: Roche Holding Ltd's Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd and Gilead Sciences Inc said on Thursday they began Phase II human testing in the United States of GS 4104, an orally-delivered compound designed to treat and prevent viral influenza.
In the program, comprised of two studies, healthy volunteers will receive oral capsules of GS 4104 or placebo once or twice daily, the companies said in a joint statement.
One study is a treatment trial, designed to determine the effect of GS 4104 in reducing symptoms after exposure to a research strain of influenza, they said.
The other study was a prophylaxis trial designed to assess the effect of GS 4104 in preventing infection by administering drug before exposure to the influenza strain, they said.
Roche and Gilead said they recently conducted a Phase I program to test the safety, tolerability and absorption of GS 4104 in humans.

In September 1996, Gilead and Roche said they entered into a worldwide collaborative agreement to co-develop and commercialize orally administered anti-influenza compounds discovered by Gilead researchers.
